data.title: Policy Amendment No. 1 – Private Liability Insurance
data.summary: Muster Versicherung AG issued Nachtrag Nr. 1 to Sam Rivera's private liability insurance policy (Privat-Haftpflichtversicherung, Vers.-Nr. PHV 71-4471220), dated 19.01.2026, to record an updated address and bank account. The next annual premium of 59,90 € will be collected by SEPA direct debit on 01.12.2026.
data.explanation: This is an updated insurance certificate (Versicherungsschein) for your private liability insurance, issued after you notified the insurer of your new address and bank details — no action is required from you. It replaces the earlier certificate and confirms your cover (up to 10,000,000 € combined, no deductible) is unchanged. The policy renews automatically each year unless cancelled in writing at least three months before the insurance year ends; the app tracks that cancellation window separately, so you don't need to calculate it yourself. Your next annual premium of 59.90 € will be debited automatically from your account on 01.12.2026 via SEPA direct debit — make sure the account has sufficient funds. Keep this document; the premium may be deductible as a special expense (Sonderausgabe) in your German tax return.
